checkpoints.title: Config: [identity] exchange, the HTTPS URL of the owner's token exchange
contracts: config.Identity.Exchange: an https URL with no path, query, or user info; validation names a bad value
checkpoints.rollback: revert the PR; an unset exchange keeps today's per-repository App

checkpoints.title: The exchange's setup service and init --identity through it: a one-time setup state authorised by an allowlisted host OIDC token, the manifest callback that converts the code and imports the key into Key Vault, polling from init, and reuse of the owner's App on later repositories
contracts: cmd/aayudha-exchange: flags and environment, serves internal/exchange.Server
exchange.Server: POST /v1/setup, GET /setup/start, GET /setup/callback, GET /v1/setup/{state}, GET /v1/app
exchange.Verifier: RS256/ES256 JWTs against the issuer's JWKS, exact issuer, subject and audience
exchange.KeyVault: the RSA key imported as non-exportable, signing JWTs through Key Vault's sign operation
initrepo.Extras.Exchange: the exchange client; with it, app() runs no manifest flow of its own and writes no secret
Env.exchangeSetup: the host's OIDC token, the start link, polling until created, failed, or an hour
instrumentation: one structured log line per setup step with the owner, the state's first 6 characters, and the result; never the code or key
the init report names the identity step's result: created through the exchange, reused, not covered
checkpoints.rollback: stop the service; no repository depends on it until story 3 of Decision #576
